title: Canonical composite overlap transport satisfies the cartesian object pin
statement: For arbitrary schemes X, K, Y, C, T, S, composable f : K → Y and gk : X → K with gk ≫ f = g, cartesian presentations of f and g over q : T → S and b : C → S, and an arrow l : b → q in Over S, let W = U ∩ V and s = W.ι ≫ pY. Let r be gk restricted to the inverse images of W and m = baseChangeMap s l. Assume the canonical cartesian isomorphisms satisfy eY.inv ≫ r = m ≫ eK.inv. For any objects A on U, B on V, E on X and local identifications phiU, phiV of their pullbacks with exact restrictions of E, form transportDataOfComposite, its prescribed psi, the fixed stage and apex equivalences, their canonical object isomorphisms sigma and rho, and eta = perfectOverlapNaturalComparisonOfSquare. For either Boolean branch a, apex.map(psi(a).hom) ≫ rho(a).hom ≫ perfectHomComparison(s,l).hom(objects(a)) equals eta.hom(F(a)) ≫ derivedPullback(m).map(sigma(a).hom). These constructions use the derived category, two-open comparison data, fixed pullback composition comparisons and cartesian overlap equivalences of the statement dependencies.

source.place: First paragraph of the proof: restriction of the two local pullback identifications to their overlap; compare Tags 08DW and 0D5S.

proof.text: For each Boolean branch choose L = U or V and its object A or B. Lift the pulled-back object to the global derived category of K using perfectOverlapOpenLiftObject and perfectOverlapOpenLiftIso. Naturality of gamma transports its inverse component to this lift. The coherence equation of TwoOpenComparisonDiagram expresses that inverse as HW(alpha), betaW inverse, tau inverse, and SP(beta).

Insert the defining theta = kappa followed by inverse-site(phi) and openSiteReturnIso. Apply openSiteReturn_overlap_triangle and naturality along phi, then the component formula of perfectOverlapRestrictionBeta. Cancel the equivalence unit and counit and the inverse-forward components. This identifies the site part with the exact nested-open comparison used in perfectOverlapApexObjectIso.

Expand the remaining perfectOverlapStageObjectIso, perfectOverlapNaturalComparisonOfSquare and perfectHomComparison. The two sides are reassociations of pullback along the same scheme maps. Apply the associativity law of the fixed counit-pinned perfectHomComposition, use hmap to identify the two cartesian composites, and use baseChangeMap_fst for the first projection. The canonical open-inclusion comparisons are the left-derived comparisons of the same restriction maps, so their localization normalizations agree.

Transport the equality back along the lift isomorphism by naturality and cancel its inverse. This gives the false branch. The identical argument with V, B and the second coherence square gives the true branch. No perfection, compactness, cover, directedness or colimit assumption enters this component identity. Substitute the equalities specifying the four comparison parameters to obtain the equation-interface form.

theorem perfect_overlap_composite_object_pin
    {X Y K C T S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : K ⟶ Y) (gk : X ⟶ K) (g : X ⟶ Y) (hgf : gk ≫ f = g)
    (pX : X ⟶ C) (pK : K ⟶ T) (pY : Y ⟶ S)
    (b : C ⟶ S) (q : T ⟶ S)
    (hg : IsPullback g pX pY b) (hf : IsPullback f pK pY q)
    (l : Over.mk b ⟶ Over.mk q)
    (U V : Y.Opens)
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (φU : (derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
    (φV : (derivedPullback (g ∣_ V)).obj B ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) :
  let W := U ⊓ V
  let s := W.ι ≫ pY
  let r := gk.resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hgf])
  let m := baseChangeMap s l
  let eY := ((isPullback_morphismRestrict g W).paste_vert hg).isoPullback
  let eK := ((isPullback_morphismRestrict f W).paste_vert hf).isoPullback
  ∀ hmap : eY.inv ≫ r = m ≫ eK.inv,
  let data := transportDataOfComposite f gk g hgf U V A B E φU φV
  let F : Bool → schemeDerivedCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme := fun a ↦
    if a then
      (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction K
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).obj B)
    else
      (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction K
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).obj A)
  let SP := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U))).mapDerivedCategory
  let SQ := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V))).mapDerivedCategory
  let τU := (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))
    (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)))).symm ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)))
  let τV := (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).symm ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
  let ψ : ∀ a, data.d.toDiagram.HW.obj (F a) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E := fun a ↦
    Bool.casesOn a
      (data.d.toDiagram.γU.symm.app ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).obj A) ≪≫
        SP.mapIso data.θU ≪≫ τU.app E)
      (data.d.toDiagram.γV.symm.app ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).obj B) ≪≫
        SQ.mapIso data.θV ≪≫ τV.app E)
  let apex := perfectOverlapApexEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V
  let η := perfectOverlapNaturalComparisonOfSquare g f pX pK pY b q hg hf U V r m hmap
  let σ : ∀ a : Bool,
      (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence f pK pY q hf U V).functor.obj (F a) ≅
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s q)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) := fun a ↦
    Bool.casesOn a
      ((perfectOverlapStageObjectIso f pK pY q hf U V U inf_le_left).app A)
      ((perfectOverlapStageObjectIso f pK pY q hf U V V inf_le_right).app B)
  let ρ : ∀ a : Bool, apex.functor.obj
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ≅
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s b)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) := fun a ↦
    Bool.casesOn a
      (perfectOverlapApexObjectIso g pX pY b hg U V U inf_le_left A E φU)
      (perfectOverlapApexObjectIso g pX pY b hg U V V inf_le_right B E φV)
  ∀ (σ' : ∀ a : Bool,
      (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence f pK pY q hf U V).functor.obj (F a) ≅
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s q)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A))
    (ρ' : ∀ a : Bool, apex.functor.obj
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ≅
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s b)).obj
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A))
    (η' : data.d.toDiagram.HW ⋙ apex.functor ≅
      (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence f pK pY q hf U V).functor ⋙ derivedPullback m)
    (χ' : derivedPullback (pullback.fst s b) ≅
      derivedPullback (pullback.fst s q) ⋙ derivedPullback m),
    σ' = σ → ρ' = ρ → η' = η → χ' = perfectHomComparison s l →
  ∀ a : Bool,
    apex.functor.map (ψ a).hom ≫ (ρ' a).hom ≫
        χ'.hom.app
          (if a then (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ V))).obj B
          else (derivedPullback (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ U))).obj A) =
      η'.hom.app (F a) ≫ (derivedPullback m).map (σ' a).hom
